production_code_evidence.source: pinned dirian/class_public source/perturbations.c plus the RTK Khronon production patch
production_code_evidence.class_contract: Each species continuity equation contains theta+metric_continuity and each Euler equation contains metric_euler; the DBI-Khronon derivative patch likewise passes phi_prime and psi into khr_perturb_derivs_newtonian.

derivation: Let y denote the collection of matter/radiation/Khronon perturbation variables and M=(phi_prime,psi,...) the scalar metric forcing. The production perturbation system has the schematic form y'=F[y,M].
The legacy RT production histories therefore solve y_RT'=F[y_RT,M_RT]. Their stress histories s_RT=S[y_RT] are functionals of the legacy RT metric history, not gravity-independent external data.

A self-consistent completed-U1 solution instead solves y_U1'=F[y_U1,M_U1] together with M_U1=G_U1[y_U1] (plus the completion auxiliary/boundary equations). In general M_U1 != M_RT implies y_U1 != y_RT and hence s_U1 != s_RT.
C10.27 froze s=s_RT and tested the one-way map M=G_U1[s_RT]. Under its finite-M_c and finite-chi assumptions, C_com=O(k^2) is necessary for regularity of that imported-forcing replay.

Failure of G_U1[s_RT] does not imply absence of a fixed point of the coupled map y'=F[y,G_U1[y]]. The imported legacy history s_RT is not required to be a fixed point of the completed-U1 coupled system.

Conversely, a detached fixed-source PASS would only show compatibility of that forcing history and would not establish dynamical stability, initial-condition consistency, or a completed-action likelihood.

formal_scope_of_C10_27.does_exclude: A regular detached completed-U1 solution on the frozen raw legacy RT source histories at the preregistered smallest-k/core-epoch criteria and finite-M_c, finite-chi assumptions.
does_not_exclude: a regular self-consistent completed-U1 matter+metric solution after reintegrating the Boltzmann/fluid/Khronon perturbations with completed-U1 metric feedback
a different completed-U1 initial/boundary prescription consistent with the coupled constraints
a numerically justified resolved-k domain after an independently frozen convergence protocol

consequence_for_architecture: Do not promote raw legacy RT stress histories to immutable physical sources for the final completion. They remain useful controls and initial guesses. After completing the source/constraint audit, the physically decisive cosmological gate must be an opt-in coupled shadow that reintegrates perturbations with completed-U1 metric feedback, leaving the historical production solver untouched.
non_claims: does not prove that the coupled completed-U1 system is regular
does not remove the need for a finite-k conditioning/initial-condition audit
does not select M_c, lambda_HL, Pcal or alpha1
does not alter any historical likelihood result
